regime_context: The detector shows a broad defensive/non-AI leadership cluster (Big Pharma, Health Care EW, Defensives, Staples, Retail) with strong durability (0.77-0.85), wide breadth, and high crowding — while all AI/semiconductor themes rank at the bottom and are ineligible. The absolute-trend gate is validated (helpful) on this market's history, so staying-power/vol-control is the only leg with a real edge; momentum rank is a focus lens only. Gate helps, but direction accuracy is weak (0.41), so I will keep conviction low and make one or two falsifiable leans rather than over-thematize.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the ineligible Memory, HBM & Storage leader (score 1.633, but durability_bar only 0.33 and breadth 0.0) sustains its high momentum score enough to become trend-gate eligible again — the observable condition to retire this watch is 'memory_storage becomes eligible=true' while SPY remains above its own trend line, which would flag a confirmed handoff back to AI leadership; if instead its durability_bar stays under 0.5 and the score decays below Big Pharma's, I drop the watch.
